title: Amortization schedule row
description: One row of a loan amortization schedule CSV. Each CSV cell is a string. Rules LOAN-001 to LOAN-005 in rules/loan-rules.csv apply across rows.

Payment.description: Payment number, 1 to N with no gaps.

Date.description: Due date of the payment, YYYY-MM-DD.

Total paid.description: Interest plus principal for this payment.

Interest.description: Balance owed before the payment x annual rate / 12, rounded to the cent.

Principal.description: Total paid minus interest. Reduces the loan.

Balance after.description: Balance before minus principal. 0.00 after the last payment.
